coach.headline: Long pauses on the middle hold cost you
coach.summary: You stuck every hold on the first try, but you hung on the big green hold in the middle for over 10 seconds before moving again. Your left foot was a great anchor, but your hips stayed far from the wall while you waited.

strengths.title: Perfect first-touch precision
strengths.detail: Every single placement stuck the first time. You did not have to re-grab or adjust your hands on any hold.

strengths.title: Stable left foot anchor
strengths.detail: Your left foot stayed on the green hold near the start for 6.8 seconds. That gave you a solid base to push from while you moved your right side.

focus.title: Long hang on middle hold
focus.detail: You paused for 7.4 seconds on the big green hold in the middle before moving your right foot. This caused your arms to fatigue and your hips to drift away from the wall. Try to move your right foot to the next hold within 2 seconds of reaching the middle hold.

focus.title: Second pause before left hand
focus.detail: After moving your right foot, you paused again for 3.3 seconds before reaching for the green hold near the top. This second hang added more strain to your arms. Aim to reach for the top hold immediately after your right foot lands.

drills.name: 2-second move timer
drills.how: Climb the problem and set a mental timer. You must make a move within 2 seconds of reaching a stable position.

drills.name: Hip-to-wall focus
drills.how: On the big green hold in the middle, focus on pulling your hips close to the wall before you think about the next hand.

coach.beta: Start on the big green hold on the right, step up to the big green hold in the middle, move your right foot up, and reach for the green hold near the top on the left.
coach.next_goal: Complete the sequence in under 10 seconds with no pauses longer than 2 seconds.
